extracted.intended_audience: general readers, literary scholars, and Project Gutenberg users interested in Benjamin Franklin's Autobiography or historical text transcriptions
extracted.subtask_description: Producing and publishing a public-domain transcription/edition of Benjamin Franklin's Autobiography for Project Gutenberg, including editorial and production notes and license text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retain original punctuation and spelling
rubrics_metrics.description: We have retained the original punctuation and spelling in the book, but there are a few exceptions. See the Detailed Notes Section of these notes for a list of changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transcribers should preserve original orthography and punctuation to match the source edition; any editorial corrections must be minimal, justified, and documented. In this edition three editorial changes were made (to match other transcriptions in Project Gutenberg) and are noted; many misspellings exist and are left as in the original unless explicitly listed in Detailed Notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document production choices in Transcriber's/Production Notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide clear production notes explaining structural and editorial decisions (e.g., 'This book contained no chapters and no table of contents'; navigation tools added; correspondence of parts to standard breaks).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include an Introduction/Production Notes section that records decisions made by the transcriber (such as added navigation, how part breaks were chosen, which quotations or supplementary material were added), and point readers to any Detailed Notes for specifics. Note provenance (edition used) and links to scanned copies when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: State added editorial material explicitly
rubrics_metrics.description: Quotations of 'On Franklin's Autobiography' and other editorial additions were added by the transcriber and are indicated in the text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any supplementary material inserted by the transcriber (introductions, quotations, added extracts) must be clearly identified as transcriber additions and placed in production notes or marked in the text so readers can distinguish original content from editorial additions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comply with and display Project Gutenberg license and trademark terms
rubrics_metrics.description: The full Project Gutenberg License is included and users/distributors must comply with its terms (read/accept license before use; follow redistribution and trademark rules).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the Full Project Gutenberg License and a clear statement about permissible uses and restrictions (especially regarding commercial redistribution and trademark use). Provide the license URL and remind users that updated editions will replace prior ones; follow the license's specific redistribution and attribution requirements.
